title: Multi-expert Prompting Improves Reliability, Safety and Usefulness of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates Large Language Models on safety, reliability, and truthfulness using benchmarks like HONEST (for hurtfulness) and BOLD (for toxicity). It specifically focuses on moral and ethical reasoning by simulating an 'Ethicist' persona and analyzing multifaceted responses to ethical questions, such as the ethics of eating meat, to demonstrate improvements in the models' handling of complex moral dilemmas.
